Name: Krobus Children for Use with Unique Children Mod
Author: Fynzou
Description:
For those who like me, do the long-way around of having kids with Krobus, by marrying one person, having kids with them, then divorcing them and becoming "roommates" with Krobus - this mod gives you the ability to change your children to look like the product of you and Krobus thanks to the Unique Children Mod.

Installation Instructions:

1. Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url] mod.
2. Move the "Krobus" folder into either (or both) the "Adopted" and "Natural" folders in the assets folder of the Unique Children Mod.
3. Launch Stardew Valley once, pass at least one day to save again (required so the json saves your save file/children), then close it.
4. Open the children.json of Unique Children and find your game, and for each child, edit "Child_Sprites" and "Spouse_Name" to "Krobus" and label "Child_Adopted" as "False" if you installed this in the Adopted Folder, or "True" if installed in the Natural Folder.
5. Save and re-launch Stardew, and enjoy your new void children.

Here is an example of what your children.json could look like:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/6w6nzzx/image.png[/img]﻿

In the top example, Alec is adopted. His biological parent is Krobus, but his current father is Sebastian, who you are married to.

In the bottom example, Lily is a natural born child of Krobus and you, and you are currently "married" to Krobus.

The Unique Children mod does not change any dialogue options, but has customization for people who want complex backstories for their children.

This mod contains assets from Unique Children, which in itself contains assets from SVE. I have received permission from the Unique Children author, and they received permission from SVE. If SVE does not wish their assets to be used, please let me know. As the author no longer remembers which assets are from SVE, I do not know who to approach to ask, as such, I gave credit to SVE as a whole.
